title: A salesman drives past the Sodankylä mast
description: A sales rep who has never been inside a site reports what he saw from the road: half-flooded track, 'the mast with the red-white tower'. Colleagues identify the site, then a team lead gives the real access knowledge. Tests a lay observation turning into an access assertion bound to the site, not to an element.
subject: #field-north

messages.text: hei, not my area but I drove past the Sodankylä mast road on my way to a customer and the track is half under water 😬
huge puddle where the road turns to gravel. my car almost didn't make it
which mast? we have Kemijärvi and Sodankylä
Sodankylä, the one on the fell with the red and white tower
heavy rain or thaw, it does that every year. only the 4x4 gets through, regular vans get stuck. ask me how I know 😅
and if it's really bad, park at the fork 800 m before the gate and walk the rest
I'm going there on Thursday with the van!! should I swap?
yes take the 4x4 from the Rovaniemi pool, I'll book it ✅
happy to help 🙂 I'll drive past again tomorrow and tell you if it dries up

items.summary: After heavy rain or thaw the access road to SITE-NF-021 (Sodankylä fell mast) floods; use a 4x4, and if it is very bad park at the fork 800 m before the gate and walk.
items.action: Take a 4x4 (Rovaniemi pool); in bad conditions park at the fork 800 m before the gate and walk.
avoid: go in with a regular van
items.fact: The track to SITE-NF-021 floods where the road turns to gravel.
items.evidence: seq 6-7: 'only the 4x4 gets through' / 'park at the fork 800 m before the gate'
